name: Nan Nan Resources Enterprise Limited
summary: Nan Nan Resources Enterprise Limited is an investment holding company that mines and sells coal in mainland China, Hong Kong, Singapore, the UK and Malaysia. It holds mining rights to the Kaiyuan open pit coal mine in Xinjiang and also has renewable energy, solar farm development and IT services segments. Incorporated in 1995 and based in Admiralty, it is owned by Ascent Goal Investments Limited and used to be called International Resources Enterprise Limited.
